description: This source file defines two custom attributes, ImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute and RegexImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute, used to mark Orleans grains for implicit stream subscriptions with specific namespace predicates and binding configurations.

classes.name: ImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute
classes.description: An attribute for binding Orleans grains to implicit stream subscriptions with namespace predicates and mapping configuration.

classes.name: RegexImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute
classes.description: A specialized attribute extending ImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute to filter streams with regular expressions.

methods.name: GetBindings
methods.description: Generates binding key-value pairs for stream subscription based on grain class and type, with support for legacy grain types.
